fields.name: conf_initial_harm
fields.label: Initials: Safety. My counselor may share information to protect me or someone else from serious harm.

fields.name: conf_initial_abuse
fields.label: Initials: Abuse reporting. My counselor must report suspected abuse or neglect of a child, an elder, or a dependent adult.

fields.name: conf_initial_legal
fields.label: Initials: Legal. A court order or other law may require my counselor to release information.

fields.name: conf_initial_insurance
fields.label: Initials: Insurance. If I use insurance, the minimum information needed for billing will be shared.

fields.name: conf_initial_consult
fields.label: Initials: Consultation and supervision. My counselor may consult with professionals without using my name, and a supervisor named above (if any) may review my information under the same confidentiality rules.

fields.name: conf_initial_electronic
fields.label: Initials: Electronic. Email, text, and video have privacy risks, and I chose my contact methods above.

fields.name: conf_initial_technology
fields.label: Initials: Technology. I understand how secure software and AI-assisted tools may be used, and I made my choice above.

fields.name: conf_initial_faith
fields.label: Initials: Faith community. Nothing will be shared with my church or pastor without my written release.
